## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `ManageRuntimes`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `manage-runtimes`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **ManageRuntimes**.

## Step 2: Manage secrets

1. <!-- manual: Navigate to the Runtimes section at the integration level, then click Manage Secrets on any environment section. -->
2. The secrets panel opens showing all secrets for that environment - both bound (claimed by a runtime) and unbound (not yet claimed by any runtime).
3. <!-- manual: If there are no secrets, the panel shows: "No secrets for this integration in this environment." -->
4. <!-- manual: Click the delete icon next to a secret to revoke it. -->
